parameters.query: WITH prepared AS (SELECT d.* FROM public.create_delivery_attempt($1::bigint,$6,'offer:'||$1::text||':'||$6,$8,$2) d WHERE $5::bigint IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.*,TRUE AS should_send FROM public.lead_routing_delivery_attempts a JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o0 ON o0.current_delivery_attempt_id=a.attempt_id JOIN public.agents g ON g.agent_id=a.target_agent_id AND g.is_available=true AND g.whatsapp_number=a.target_number WHERE $5::bigint IS NOT NULL AND a.attempt_id=$5::bigint AND a.opportunity_id=$1::bigint AND a.routing_tier=$6 AND a.status='requested' AND a.provider_message_id IS NULL AND a.lease_token=$7 AND a.lease_expires_at>NOW()) SELECT prepared.*,prepared.target_number AS number,$3 AS text,$4 AS button_id,COALESCE(NULLIF($9,''),NULLIF(c.current_property,''),NULLIF(o.property_id,''),'Propiedad sin referencia') AS property_details,COALESCE(NULLIF($10,''),'Consultar en CRM') AS property_price,COALESCE(NULLIF($11,''),NULLIF(c.lead_name,''),'Sin nombre') AS lead_name,COALESCE(NULLIF($12,''),NULLIF(c.lead_phone,''),NULLIF(o.e164_phone,''),'Sin telefono') AS lead_phone,'TOMO-V2-'||prepared.opportunity_id::text||'-'||CASE prepared.routing_tier WHEN 'owner' THEN 'O' WHEN 'primary_guard' THEN 'P' ELSE 'B' END AS claim_code,'5'::text AS sla_minutes FROM prepared JOIN public.lead_routing_opportunities o ON o.opportunity_id=prepared.opportunity_id LEFT JOIN public.conversations c ON c.conversation_id=o.conversation_id;
